society.skycraft.say.region.anequina: Red sandstone mesas, dry dust-winds, and desert wells define the northern badlands of Anequina from Riverhold to Dune and Orcrest.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.1: Anequina is the high plateau of the north: red sandstone mesas over dry steppe, cut by badland gullies where the Renrijra Krin hide.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.3: Dune's market wheel turns on caravan traffic;.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.4: Here in Anequina, the land is shaped by mesas and buttes up to 150 blocks, and every traveler learns to read the ground.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.5: Watch the sky when spring dust gales across the tableland sets in across Anequina—it changes the roads in an hour.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.6: Our people draw their living along the one perennial stream, fed by seepage, where water and road meet.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.7: Don't stray far into short gold grass and scattered acacia after dusk unless you carry steel and a steady lantern.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.8: The markets of Anequina turn on well-to-well pack trains, and every caravan counts the weight twice.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.9: From the northern seat on its stream, the watch-horns carry clear across banded clay canyons.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.10: Ask anyone in Anequina who holds the reins and they'll point you to northern kin-groups holding the oases.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.11: Even in hard seasons, folk here keep the rites of high moon-shrines watching the sky.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.12: Tempers run sharp over the royal court at Riverhold whenever the tax-scribes and patrols ride through Anequina.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.13: Give a wide berth to hidden rebel redoubts—scavengers who go in rarely bring their packs back out.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.14: The elders still tell of the plateau city older than the kingdoms, written into the stones of Anequina.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.15: Between mesas and buttes up to 150 blocks and Nevoe, Temar and Kojanar oases on the caravan line, there's no mistaking the borders of Anequina.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.16: When sharp desert temperature swings sweeps over bare red rock and lone thorn trees, even veteran guides keep to market city where five caravan routes meet.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.17: Traders dealing in nix-oxen and goat herding always pay their dues to wealthy factors of Dune and Riverhold before unlashing a single bale.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.18: You can still see the mark of a battlefield of the old wars where blades still stand planted near scorched dragon bone field, if you know where to look.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.19: Whether you answer to northern kin-groups holding the oases or just haul well-to-well pack trains, the resented Thalmor census of wells touches every hearth in Anequina.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.20: At the shrines of the dragon bone fields are not walked at night, travelers leave offerings before crossing banded clay canyons.
society.skycraft.say.anequina.21: Out beyond the northern seat on its stream, bare red rock and lone thorn trees and hidden rebel redoubts test anyone who wanders off the beaten track.

society.skycraft.say.rimmen.2: Rimmen is a city of artisans built on a cliff directly over its own necropolis;.

society.skycraft.say.torval.2: Torval is the Mane's city of concentric rings and twin golden domes, where pilgrims climb the processional road at moonrise.

society.skycraft.say.pellitine.1: Pellitine is the wet south-west: river terraces and floodplain cane fields running into the Tenmar jungle and the Valenwood gate.
society.skycraft.say.pellitine.2: Corinthe is the garden city of canals;.

society.skycraft.chat.gossip_torval.2.1: In Torval, nobody forgets the two years without moons, when temple bells were rung at the hour they vanished—every stone of the central escarpment's southern foot still bears the mark.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_torval.2.2: True enough. Keeps a body humble when walking past the spiritual centre of the Lunar Lattice at dusk.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_torval.3.0: The scouts say something stirred near ancient lunar sanctuaries on the knolls out beyond green strip of palms and grass under the arches, %1$s.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_torval.3.1: Nothing good ever comes out of bent spirits haunting the sealed shrines; even the hunters in Torval stay clear of that ground.
society.skycraft.chat.gossip_torval.3.2: Tell that to the fools hoping to salvage relics from ancient lunar sanctuaries on the knolls before crystalline night skies over the knolls closes the trail.
